rb1_up_small_order_presence.sql: WITH ob AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.order_id, count(DISTINCT l.product_id) AS nprod FROM lines l JOIN users u ON u.user_id = l.user_id GROUP BY l.user_id, l.order_id), um AS (SELECT user_id, median(nprod) AS med FROM ob GROUP BY user_id), oc AS (SELECT ob.user_id, ob.order_id, CASE WHEN ob.nprod <= um.med THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS small FROM ob JOIN um ON um.user_id = ob.user_id), tt AS (SELECT user_id, sum(small) AS n_small FROM oc GROUP BY user_id), up AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.product_id, l.order_id FROM lines l JOIN cand c ON c.user_id = l.user_id AND c.product_id = l.product_id), upc AS (SELECT up.user_id, up.product_id, sum(oc.small) AS s, count(*) AS n FROM up JOIN oc ON oc.order_id = up.order_id GROUP BY up.user_id, up.product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, (COALESCE(upc.s, 0) + 0.0) / (tt.n_small + 1.0) AS ag_rb1_up_small_share, (upc.s + 0.5) / (upc.n + 1.0) AS ag_rb1_up_small_frac FROM cand c JOIN tt ON tt.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN upc ON upc.user_id = c.user_id AND upc.product_id = c.product_id

rb1_user_promo_sensitivity.sql: WITH ul AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.product_id, l.order_id, CASE WHEN l.discount > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS promo FROM lines l JOIN users u ON u.user_id = l.user_id), pc AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_ord FROM ul GROUP BY user_id, product_id) SELECT ul.user_id, avg(ul.promo) AS ag_rb1_u_promo_share, (sum(CASE WHEN pc.n_ord = 1 THEN ul.promo ELSE 0.0 END) + 0.2) / (sum(CASE WHEN pc.n_ord = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 1.0) AS ag_rb1_u_trial_promo_share FROM ul JOIN pc ON pc.user_id = ul.user_id AND pc.product_id = ul.product_id GROUP BY ul.user_id

rb1_assortment_recency.sql: WITH ur AS (SELECT o.user_id, o.retailer, count(*) AS n, max(o.ts) AS last_ts FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY o.user_id, o.retailer), mr AS (SELECT user_id, retailer FROM (SELECT user_id, retailer, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY n DESC, last_ts DESC, retailer) AS rn FROM ur) z WHERE rn = 1), lst AS (SELECT user_id, store_id FROM (SELECT o.user_id, o.store_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.ts DESC, o.order_id DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id) z WHERE rn = 1), pr AS (SELECT o.retailer, l.product_id, max(l.ts) AS last_ts FROM lines l JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE l.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand) AND o.retailer IN (SELECT retailer FROM mr) GROUP BY o.retailer, l.product_id), pst AS (SELECT o.store_id, l.product_id, max(l.ts) AS last_ts FROM lines l JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE l.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand) AND o.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lst) GROUP BY o.store_id, l.product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, COALESCE(epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - pr.last_ts) / 86400.0, 121.0) AS ag_rb1_pr_days_since_sale, COALESCE(epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - pst.last_ts) / 86400.0, 121.0) AS ag_rb1_ps_days_since_sale FROM cand c JOIN mr ON mr.user_id = c.user_id JOIN lst ON lst.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN pr ON pr.retailer = mr.retailer AND pr.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN pst ON pst.store_id = lst.store_id AND pst.product_id = c.product_id

rb1_p_launch_age_activity.sql: WITH pd AS (SELECT product_id, min(ts) AS first_ts, count(DISTINCT CAST(ts AS DATE)) FILTER (WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY) AS active_days FROM lines GROUP BY product_id) SELECT product_id, epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - first_ts) / 86400.0 AS ag_rb1_p_days_since_first, active_days / 28.0 AS ag_rb1_p_active_days_28 FROM pd

rb1_uc_price_tier_fit.sql: WITH pp AS (SELECT product_id, median(price) AS p_med, min(master_category_id) AS cat FROM lines WHERE price > 0 AND product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand) GROUP BY product_id), cm AS (SELECT master_category_id AS cat, median(price) AS c_med FROM lines WHERE price > 0 AND master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY master_category_id), uc AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.master_category_id AS cat, median(l.price) AS u_med FROM lines l JOIN users u ON u.user_id = l.user_id WHERE l.price > 0 AND l.master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.user_id, l.master_category_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, ln(pp.p_med / uc.u_med) AS ag_rb1_uc_price_fit, ln(pp.p_med / cm.c_med) AS ag_rb1_p_cat_price_rel FROM cand c JOIN pp ON pp.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN uc ON uc.user_id = c.user_id AND uc.cat = pp.cat LEFT JOIN cm ON cm.cat = pp.cat

rb1_uc_variety_seeking.sql: WITH pcat AS (SELECT product_id, min(master_category_id) AS cat FROM lines WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand) GROUP BY product_id), uop AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.order_id, l.ts, l.product_id, l.master_category_id AS cat FROM lines l JOIN users u ON u.user_id = l.user_id WHERE l.master_category_id IS NOT NULL), fl AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, ts, cat, CASE WHEN row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, product_id ORDER BY ts, order_id, cat) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new FROM uop), co AS (SELECT user_id, cat, order_id, ts, max(is_new) AS has_new FROM fl GROUP BY user_id, cat, order_id, ts), cr AS (SELECT user_id, cat, has_new, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, cat ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS rn FROM co), agg AS (SELECT user_id, cat, (sum(CASE WHEN rn > 1 THEN has_new ELSE 0 END) + 0.5) / (sum(CASE WHEN rn > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 1.0) AS explore FROM cr GROUP BY user_id, cat), np AS (SELECT user_id, cat, count(DISTINCT product_id) AS n_prod FROM uop GROUP BY user_id, cat) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, CASE WHEN pcat.cat IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(np.n_prod, 0) END AS ag_rb1_uc_n_products, a.explore AS ag_rb1_uc_explore_share FROM cand c LEFT JOIN pcat ON pcat.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN np ON np.user_id = c.user_id AND np.cat = pcat.cat LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.user_id = c.user_id AND a.cat = pcat.cat

rb1_user_retailer_switching.sql: WITH uo AS (SELECT o.user_id, o.order_id, o.ts, o.retailer, o.store_id FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id), s AS (SELECT user_id, retailer, store_id, lag(retailer) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS prev_ret, lag(store_id) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS prev_store, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS k FROM uo) SELECT user_id, avg(CASE WHEN retailer IS DISTINCT FROM prev_ret THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ag_rb1_u_ret_switch, avg(CASE WHEN store_id IS DISTINCT FROM prev_store THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ag_rb1_u_store_switch FROM s WHERE k > 1 GROUP BY user_id

rb1_p_monthly_trend_retention.sql: WITH up AS (SELECT product_id, user_id, max(CASE WHEN ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent, max(CASE WHEN ts < TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prior FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 56 DAY GROUP BY product_id, user_id) SELECT product_id, ln((sum(recent) + 1.0) / (sum(prior) + 1.0)) AS ag_rb1_p_trend_28_56, (sum(recent * prior) + 1.0) / (sum(prior) + 5.0) AS ag_rb1_p_retention_28 FROM up GROUP BY product_id

rb1_up_lapse_vs_max_gap.sql: WITH uo AS (SELECT o.user_id, o.order_id, o.ts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.ts, o.order_id) AS k FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id), un AS (SELECT user_id, max(k) AS n FROM uo GROUP BY user_id), upo AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id, c.product_id, uo.ts, uo.order_id, uo.k FROM cand c JOIN lines l ON l.user_id = c.user_id AND l.product_id = c.product_id JOIN uo ON uo.order_id = l.order_id), g AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, ts, k, epoch(ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, product_id ORDER BY ts, order_id)) / 86400.0 AS gap_d, k - lag(k) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, product_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS gap_k FROM upo), a AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, max(ts) AS last_ts, max(k) AS last_k, max(gap_d) AS max_gap_d, max(gap_k) AS max_gap_k FROM g GROUP BY user_id, product_id) SELECT a.user_id, a.product_id, (epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - a.last_ts) / 86400.0) / (CASE WHEN a.max_gap_d < 0.5 THEN 0.5 ELSE a.max_gap_d END) AS ag_rb1_up_dsl_over_maxgap, (un.n - a.last_k + 0.0) / a.max_gap_k AS ag_rb1_up_osl_over_maxgap FROM a JOIN un ON un.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.max_gap_k IS NOT NULL

rb1_user_basket_state.sql: WITH ob AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.order_id, l.ts, count(DISTINCT l.product_id) AS nprod FROM lines l JOIN users u ON u.user_id = l.user_id GROUP BY l.user_id, l.order_id, l.ts), r AS (SELECT user_id, nprod, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts DESC, order_id DESC) AS rn, epoch(ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id)) / 86400.0 AS gap_d FROM ob) SELECT user_id, max(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN nprod END) / avg(nprod) AS ag_rb1_u_last_basket_rel, (sum(CASE WHEN gap_d < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 0.0) / (count(gap_d) + 1.0) AS ag_rb1_u_topup_share FROM r GROUP BY user_id

rb1_user_top_products_copurchase.sql: WITH ufreq AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.product_id AS q, count(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS n, max(l.ts) AS last_ts FROM lines l JOIN users u ON u.user_id = l.user_id GROUP BY l.user_id, l.product_id), topq AS (SELECT user_id, q FROM (SELECT user_id, q, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY n DESC, last_ts DESC, q) AS rn FROM ufreq) z WHERE rn <= 5), qo AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id AS q FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND product_id IN (SELECT q FROM topq)), qn AS (SELECT q, count(*) AS n_q FROM qo GROUP BY q), po AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand)), pn AS (SELECT product_id, count(*) AS n_p FROM po GROUP BY product_id), tot AS (SELECT count(*) AS n_o FROM orders WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY), co AS (SELECT qo.q, po.product_id, count(*) AS n_qp FROM qo JOIN po ON po.order_id = qo.order_id GROUP BY qo.q, po.product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, avg((COALESCE(co.n_qp, 0) + 5.0 * (COALESCE(pn.n_p, 0) + 0.5) / (tot.n_o + 1.0)) / (COALESCE(qn.n_q, 0) + 5.0)) AS ag_rb1_topq_co_mean, ln(avg((COALESCE(co.n_qp, 0) + 5.0 * (COALESCE(pn.n_p, 0) + 0.5) / (tot.n_o + 1.0)) / (COALESCE(qn.n_q, 0) + 5.0)) / avg((COALESCE(pn.n_p, 0) + 0.5) / (tot.n_o + 1.0))) AS ag_rb1_topq_co_lift FROM cand c JOIN topq t ON t.user_id = c.user_id AND t.q <> c.product_id CROSS JOIN tot LEFT JOIN qn ON qn.q = t.q LEFT JOIN co ON co.q = t.q AND co.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN pn ON pn.product_id = c.product_id GROUP BY c.user_id, c.product_id

rb2_up_first_order_hit.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, ts, CAST(ceil(epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - ts) / 1209600.0) AS INTEGER) AS wk FROM orders WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)), r AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, wk, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, wk ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS rn, max(wk) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS max_wk FROM o), e AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, wk, rn FROM r WHERE wk <= 8 AND wk < max_wk), nw AS (SELECT user_id, count(*) AS n_win FROM e WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY user_id), pl AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.user_id, l.product_id, e.wk, e.rn = 1 AS is_first FROM e JOIN lines l ON l.order_id = e.order_id JOIN cand c ON c.user_id = l.user_id AND c.product_id = l.product_id), h AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, count(DISTINCT wk) FILTER (WHERE is_first) AS hits, count(DISTINCT wk) AS wins FROM pl GROUP BY user_id, product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, COALESCE(h.hits, 0) * 1.0 / nw.n_win AS ag_rb2_up_win1_rate, h.hits * 1.0 / h.wins AS ag_rb2_up_win1_vs_any FROM cand c JOIN nw ON nw.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN h ON h.user_id = c.user_id AND h.product_id = c.product_id;

rb2_uc_first_order_hit.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, ts, CAST(ceil(epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - ts) / 1209600.0) AS INTEGER) AS wk FROM orders WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)), r AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, wk, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, wk ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS rn, max(wk) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS max_wk FROM o), f AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, wk FROM r WHERE rn = 1 AND wk <= 8 AND wk < max_wk), nw AS (SELECT user_id, count(*) AS n_win FROM f GROUP BY user_id), fc AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.user_id, f.wk, l.master_category_id AS cat FROM f JOIN lines l ON l.order_id = f.order_id WHERE l.master_category_id IS NOT NULL), h AS (SELECT user_id, cat, count(*) AS hits FROM fc GROUP BY user_id, cat), pc AS (SELECT product_id, min(master_category_id) AS cat FROM lines WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand) AND master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, COALESCE(h.hits, 0) * 1.0 / nw.n_win AS ag_rb2_uc_win1_rate FROM cand c JOIN nw ON nw.user_id = c.user_id JOIN pc ON pc.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN h ON h.user_id = c.user_id AND h.cat = pc.cat;

rb2_p_first_order_lift.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, ts, CAST(ceil(epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - ts) / 1209600.0) AS INTEGER) AS wk FROM orders), r AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, wk, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, wk ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS rn, max(wk) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS max_wk FROM o), e AS (SELECT order_id, rn FROM r WHERE wk <= 8 AND wk < max_wk), tot AS (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / count(*) AS base FROM e), p AS (SELECT l.product_id, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.rn = 1 THEN l.order_id END) AS n_first, count(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS n_all FROM lines l JOIN e ON e.order_id = l.order_id GROUP BY l.product_id) SELECT p.product_id, ln(((p.n_first + 20.0 * tot.base) / (p.n_all + 20.0)) / tot.base) AS ag_rb2_p_win1_lift FROM p CROSS JOIN tot;

rb2_retailer_availability.sql: WITH ur AS (SELECT user_id, retailer, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS n, max(ts) AS last_ts FROM orders WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users) GROUP BY user_id, retailer), m AS (SELECT user_id, retailer FROM (SELECT user_id, retailer, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY n DESC, last_ts DESC, retailer) AS rn FROM ur) WHERE rn = 1), s AS (SELECT o.retailer, l.product_id, max(l.ts) AS last_ts, count(DISTINCT CAST(l.ts AS DATE)) FILTER (WHERE l.ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS d14 FROM lines l JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE l.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand) AND o.retailer IN (SELECT retailer FROM m) GROUP BY o.retailer, l.product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, COALESCE(epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - s.last_ts) / 86400.0, 121.0) AS ag_rb2_pr_last_sold_days, COALESCE(s.d14, 0) AS ag_rb2_pr_sold_days14 FROM cand c JOIN m ON m.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.retailer = m.retailer AND s.product_id = c.product_id;

rb2_p_lifecycle.sql: SELECT product_id, epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - min(ts)) / 86400.0 AS ag_rb2_p_first_seen_days, count(DISTINCT CAST(ts AS DATE)) * 1.0 / greatest(1.0, ceil(epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - min(ts)) / 86400.0)) AS ag_rb2_p_active_day_share FROM lines GROUP BY product_id;

rb2_history_copurchase.sql: WITH uq AS (SELECT user_id, product_id AS q FROM (SELECT user_id, product_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY count(DISTINCT order_id) DESC, max(ts) DESC, product_id) AS rn FROM lines WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users) GROUP BY user_id, product_id) WHERE rn <= 10), ol AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY), nord AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT order_id) AS n FROM ol), qo AS (SELECT order_id, product_id AS q FROM ol WHERE product_id IN (SELECT q FROM uq)), po AS (SELECT order_id, product_id FROM ol WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand)), qc AS (SELECT q, count(*) AS nq FROM qo GROUP BY q), pc AS (SELECT product_id, count(*) AS np FROM po GROUP BY product_id), co AS (SELECT qo.q, po.product_id, count(*) AS npq FROM qo JOIN po ON po.order_id = qo.order_id WHERE po.product_id <> qo.q GROUP BY qo.q, po.product_id), x AS (SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, avg(COALESCE(co.npq, 0) * 1.0 / (qc.nq + 5.0)) AS cond FROM cand c JOIN uq ON uq.user_id = c.user_id AND uq.q <> c.product_id JOIN qc ON qc.q = uq.q LEFT JOIN co ON co.q = uq.q AND co.product_id = c.product_id GROUP BY c.user_id, c.product_id) SELECT x.user_id, x.product_id, x.cond AS ag_rb2_co_hist_cond, ln((x.cond + 0.0001) / ((COALESCE(pc.np, 0) + 1.0) / (nord.n + 1.0) + 0.0001)) AS ag_rb2_co_hist_lift FROM x CROSS JOIN nord LEFT JOIN pc ON pc.product_id = x.product_id;

rb2_retailer_promo_now.sql: WITH ur AS (SELECT user_id, retailer, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS n, max(ts) AS last_ts FROM orders WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users) GROUP BY user_id, retailer), m AS (SELECT user_id, retailer FROM (SELECT user_id, retailer, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY n DESC, last_ts DESC, retailer) AS rn FROM ur) WHERE rn = 1), s AS (SELECT o.retailer, l.product_id, avg(CASE WHEN l.discount > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE l.ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS d7, avg(CASE WHEN l.discount > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE l.ts < TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS dprev FROM lines l JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE l.ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 56 DAY AND l.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand) AND o.retailer IN (SELECT retailer FROM m) GROUP BY o.retailer, l.product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, s.d7 AS ag_rb2_pr_disc7, s.d7 - s.dprev AS ag_rb2_pr_disc_lift FROM cand c JOIN m ON m.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.retailer = m.retailer AND s.product_id = c.product_id;

rb2_uc_price_tier.sql: WITH pc AS (SELECT product_id, min(master_category_id) AS cat, median(price) FILTER (WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND price > 0) AS p_med FROM lines WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand) GROUP BY product_id), uc AS (SELECT user_id, master_category_id AS cat, median(price) AS u_med FROM lines WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users) AND price > 0 AND master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id, master_category_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, ln(pc.p_med / uc.u_med) AS ag_rb2_uc_price_tier FROM cand c JOIN pc ON pc.product_id = c.product_id JOIN uc ON uc.user_id = c.user_id AND uc.cat = pc.cat WHERE pc.p_med > 0 AND uc.u_med > 0;

rb2_up_basket_context.sql: WITH ob AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, count(DISTINCT product_id) AS bs FROM lines WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users) GROUP BY user_id, order_id), og AS (SELECT o.user_id, o.order_id, CASE WHEN epoch(o.ts - lag(o.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.ts, o.order_id)) < 172800 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS topup FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)), ub AS (SELECT ob.user_id, avg(ob.bs) AS mbs, avg(og.topup) AS mtop FROM ob JOIN og ON og.order_id = ob.order_id GROUP BY ob.user_id), pp AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.product_id, l.order_id FROM lines l JOIN cand c ON c.user_id = l.user_id AND c.product_id = l.product_id) SELECT pp.user_id, pp.product_id, avg(ob.bs) / max(ub.mbs) AS ag_rb2_up_basket_rel, avg(og.topup) - max(ub.mtop) AS ag_rb2_up_topup_rel FROM pp JOIN ob ON ob.order_id = pp.order_id JOIN og ON og.order_id = pp.order_id JOIN ub ON ub.user_id = pp.user_id GROUP BY pp.user_id, pp.product_id;

rb2_uc_variety.sql: WITH pc AS (SELECT product_id, min(master_category_id) AS cat FROM lines WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand) AND master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id), uc AS (SELECT user_id, master_category_id AS cat, count(DISTINCT product_id) * 1.0 / count(DISTINCT order_id) AS vr, count(DISTINCT product_id) AS np FROM lines WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users) AND master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id, master_category_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, uc.vr AS ag_rb2_uc_variety, uc.np AS ag_rb2_uc_n_products FROM cand c JOIN pc ON pc.product_id = c.product_id JOIN uc ON uc.user_id = c.user_id AND uc.cat = pc.cat;

rb2_up_share_trend.sql: WITH uo AS (SELECT user_id, count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY) AS n_recent, count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE ts < TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 84 DAY) AS n_prev FROM orders WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users) GROUP BY user_id), up AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.product_id, count(DISTINCT l.order_id) FILTER (WHERE l.ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY) AS k_recent, count(DISTINCT l.order_id) FILTER (WHERE l.ts < TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY) AS k_prev FROM lines l JOIN cand c ON c.user_id = l.user_id AND c.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 84 DAY GROUP BY l.user_id, l.product_id) SELECT up.user_id, up.product_id, (up.k_recent + 0.5) / (uo.n_recent + 1.0) - (up.k_prev + 0.5) / (uo.n_prev + 1.0) AS ag_rb2_up_share_trend FROM up JOIN uo ON uo.user_id = up.user_id;

rb2_uc_brand_loyalty.sql: WITH pb AS (SELECT product_id, brand_name AS brand FROM (SELECT product_id, brand_name, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC, brand_name) AS rn FROM lines WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand) AND brand_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id, brand_name) WHERE rn = 1), pc AS (SELECT product_id, min(master_category_id) AS cat FROM lines WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM cand) AND master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id), ul AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, order_id, master_category_id AS cat, brand_name AS brand FROM lines WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users) AND master_category_id IS NOT NULL), ucn AS (SELECT user_id, cat, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_cat FROM ul GROUP BY user_id, cat), ucb AS (SELECT user_id, cat, brand, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_cb FROM ul WHERE brand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id, cat, brand) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, COALESCE(ucb.n_cb, 0) * 1.0 / ucn.n_cat AS ag_rb2_ucb_share FROM cand c JOIN pc ON pc.product_id = c.product_id JOIN pb ON pb.product_id = c.product_id JOIN ucn ON ucn.user_id = c.user_id AND ucn.cat = pc.cat LEFT JOIN ucb ON ucb.user_id = c.user_id AND ucb.cat = pc.cat AND ucb.brand = pb.brand;
